verdict.rationale: Mercury documents a public, versioned REST API (/api/v1) covering accounts, transactions, payments, cards, invoicing, webhooks and treasury. It backs this with an interactive API reference (Try It, multi-language samples), scoped read-only, read-write and custom tokens, OAuth2, a sandbox with separate base URLs, a public changelog with migration guidance, an official Go SDK, and an agent-friendly llms.txt that a probe confirmed returns HTTP 200. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of driving the API (community praise is general), an OpenAPI spec at a standard discoverable path (probes of common paths returned 404), a written deprecation policy, and official SDKs beyond Go.
